topics: Greedy choices, dynamic programming and backtracking

descriptionMd:
A chain of rectangular printing plates can be multiplied in several different parenthesized orders. Sol needs the first qualifying slip while the courier waits at the door. Later matches must not jump ahead in the tray.

readings are positive matrix dimensions: matrix i has shape readings[i] by readings[i+1]. For every prefix containing 1,2,... matrices, produce its minimum scalar multiplication cost over all parenthesizations. Fewer than two dimensions produces no costs.

Return the first value in the derived sequence that is at least k, or -1 if there is none. Return the value, not its index.

Implement pressParenthesesFirstQualifyingSlip(readings, k). Use k exactly where specified above.
unitIntro: Interval dynamic programming. readings are positive matrix dimensions: matrix i has shape readings[i] by readings[i+1]. For every prefix containing 1,2,... matrices, produce its minimum scalar multiplication cost over all parenthesizations. Fewer than two dimensions produces no costs. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Every dimension is an integer from 1 through 10; there are at most 16 dimensions.

Target time O(n^3); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n^2). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with interval dynamic programming. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

readings are positive matrix dimensions: matrix i has shape readings[i] by readings[i+1]. For every prefix containing 1,2,... matrices, produce its minimum scalar multiplication cost over all parenthesizations. Fewer than two dimensions produces no costs. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the first value in the derived sequence that is at least k, or -1 if there is none. Return the value, not its index. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.
